messages:
maria: Heads up — after pushing toolkit12 to canary fleets in ap-southeast1 we started seeing a provisioning surge and a bunch of ContainerCreating pods that never finish. Nodes look healthy but kubelet can't mount nvidia libs.
ken: seeing same pattern in eu-west canary. Also got several NCCL handshake timeouts + a couple of runtime SIGABRTs on the same pods.
sam: rollback in progress for ap-southeast1 canary (image pin -> toolkit 11.8). Starting cordon/drain on affected nodes to reprovision.
liam: quick grep on failing pods shows symbol/version errors: `GLIBCXX_3.4.29` missing and `undefined symbol: __cxa_throw_bad_array_new_length` — smells like libstdc++ and compiler/runtime mismatch between host driver stack and container toolchain.
maria: exact kubelet error snippet:```
Mar 23 12:34:56 node-23 kubelet[...]: MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume \"nvidia-driver\": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to mount /var/lib/kubelet/pods/.../volumes/kubernetes.io~secret/nvidia: invalid ELF header: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6: ELFCLASS64 expected
```
ken: and runtime logs inside the container show:```
[W NVIDIA][loader] failed to open libnvidia-ml.so.1: undefined symbol: cudaGetErrorString
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what(): /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcudart.so.12: undefined symbol: __cxa_allocate_exception
```
liam: looks like some nodes have host toolkits upgraded (driver + toolkit 12) but images still built against older gcc/libstdc++ ABI, so JIT/PTX caches and linker shims are mismatched.
sam: rollout chain: cloud-provisioner applied toolkit12 -> node images updated -> container images not rebuilt -> implicit ABI mismatch. Need to pause all remaining region upgrades.
deploy-bot: :information_source: rollout job `toolkit12-canary` status: PAUSED by `sam` at 2026-03-23T12:40:10Z — reason: provisioning regressions detected.
maria: networking angle — when nodes fail ContainerCreating they hold IPs and the provisioner queue fills, we saw backpressure in ap-southeast1 causing capacity shortfalls for user workloads (latency + 502 spikes).
ken: NCCL timeouts likely secondary from partial upgrades: mixed NvPeerMemory/libnccl versions cause connection handshake failures across pods on different node generations.
liam: mitigation proposal: 1) freeze toolkit12 rollouts 2) add enforcement to provisioning: require image rebuild or `compat` label on container images, 3) implement graceful drain throttles so we don't exhaust IP pool.
sam: executing 1) and 3) now. Also starting a quick canary with nodeSelector `toolkit=12` and a matching rebuilt image in a private slot to validate before mass rollout.
maria: forensics todo: collect `ldd` on libc/libstdc++ in both host and container, dump PTX cache paths, gather `dmesg` and `kubelet` logs for affected nodes. If someone can run the following on a failed node:```bash
ssh node-23 -- sudo ldd /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcudart.so.12
sudo strings /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 | grep GLIBCXX
```
ken: I'm on it, collecting logs now and uploading to the incident bucket. Starting a short lived overlay canary using rebuilt images to confirm.
infra-oncall: tagging SRE oncall and infra-team. Noted cost/regressions: provisioning churn + reboots will bump OPEX for the week — flagging finance for delta.
liam: long term: add CI gate that runs container image compatibility check against both toolkit 11 and 12 runtime symbols before allowing rollout.
maria: agree. For now: pause, roll back canaries, drain slowly, and run the compatibility audit on our top 20 images. Will coordinate with build-bot to queue rebuilds. :white_check_mark:
